BLACK_HOLE.description: Whenever you spend or gain [star:1], deal 3 damage to ALL enemies.
BLACK_HOLE.upgrade_description: Whenever you spend or gain [star:1], deal 4 damage to ALL enemies.

DEBILITATE.description:
Deal 10 damage.
[gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective against the enemy for the next 2 turns.
DEBILITATE.upgrade_description:
Deal 12 damage.
[gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold] are twice as effective against the enemy for the next 3 turns.

ENVENOM.description: Whenever an Attack deals unblocked damage, apply 1 [gold]Poison[/gold].
ENVENOM.upgrade_description: Whenever an Attack deals unblocked damage, apply 2 [gold]Poison[/gold].

FLANKING.description: The enemy takes double attack damage from other players this turn.

KNOCKDOWN.description:
Deal 10 damage.
The enemy takes double damage from other players this turn.
KNOCKDOWN.upgrade_description:
Deal 14 damage.
The enemy takes triple damage from other players this turn.

OUTBREAK.description: Every 3 times you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], deal 11 damage to ALL enemies.
OUTBREAK.upgrade_description: Every 3 times you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], deal 15 damage to ALL enemies.

SLEIGHT_OF_FLESH.description: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, they take 9 damage.
SLEIGHT_OF_FLESH.upgrade_description: Whenever you apply a debuff to an enemy, they take 13 damage.

SMOKESTACK.description: Whenever you create a Status, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
SMOKESTACK.upgrade_description: Whenever you create a Status, deal 7 damage to ALL enemies.

SNEAKY.description: Whenever another player attacks an enemy, gain 1 [gold]Block[/gold].
SNEAKY.upgrade_description: Whenever another player attacks an enemy, gain 2 [gold]Block[/gold].

THUNDER.description: Whenever you [gold]Evoke Lightning[/gold], deal 6 damage to each enemy hit.
THUNDER.upgrade_description: Whenever you [gold]Evoke Lightning[/gold], deal 8 damage to each enemy hit.
